name: YXX Smart Watermark
author: yanxuanxiang

sections.description:
YXX Smart Watermark protects your original images with text or logo watermarks. Perfect for photographers, designers, and content creators who want to protect their visual assets.

Free Features:
* Text watermarks with customizable font, size, color, and opacity
* Image/Logo watermarks
* Automatic watermark on upload
* 9 position anchors (top-left, top-center, top-right, etc.)
* Per-size control (thumbnail, medium, large, full)
* Works with JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP formats
* Lightweight — no impact on frontend performance

Why use Smart Watermark?
Protect your images from unauthorized use. Watermarks deter image theft while maintaining professional appearance.

External Services

This plugin does not connect to any external services. All functionality runs entirely on your own server.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → YXX Smart Watermark to configure
  4. Choose watermark type (text or image), position, and settings
  5. Done! New uploads will be automatically watermarked
sections.faq:
Does this slow down my site?

No. Watermarking happens during image upload only. There is zero impact on frontend page load speed.

Can I watermark existing images?

The free version watermarks new uploads only. For bulk watermarking of existing images, upgrade to Pro.

Will it work with all image formats?

Yes. The plugin supports JPEG, PNG, GIF, and WebP formats.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. The plugin doesn’t store any user data or make external requests.

Does this plugin make any external requests?

No. The free version runs entirely on your server. No data is sent anywhere.
